constraints.name: limited_reorder_divisible_set
constraints.description: Chef can reorder the menu only by permuting dishes whose flavour M_i is divisible by p. Dishes not divisible by p must stay in their original positions.
constraints.formal: For a given p, let S = {i | p divides M_i}. The new menu M' must satisfy: for all i not in S, M'_i = M_i; and the multiset of values on indices in S is permuted arbitrarily.

constraints.name: prime_parameter
constraints.description: The favourite ingredient p in each query is a prime number.
